artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: PORTAL repo, branch wk-irpt_fntend-2-1-fe-s-12, commit 2750d80b (LOCAL). Three repairs, all inside this file: (1) test.each([...])('row %s', (_name, row) => ...) replaced by a plain `for (const row of census.components)` loop registering one test(`row ${row.component}`, ...) per row -- same names, same assertions, and `row` now carries its declared ComponentRow type, which removes the two TS7006 implicit-any parameters without an annotation; (2) the same conversion for the PRD accounting loop, names `PRD reuse row #<n>`, removing two more TS7006s; (3) expect(row.path).not.toMatch(/\(UNRESOLVED/) replaced by expect(UNRESOLVED_MARKER.test(row.path ?? '')).toBe(false), since `toMatch` is not on the shim's Matchers interface. UNRESOLVED_MARKER is module-level and carries NO `g` flag deliberately -- a global regex retains lastIndex between .test() calls and would have made the new per-row loop order-dependent. Six of the eight base TS errors are in this file and all six are gone.

PORTAL repo, branch wk-irpt_fntend-2-1-fe-s-12, commit 2750d80b (LOCAL). One repair: walkTsx's `readdirSync(dir)` + `statSync(abs).isDirectory()` replaced by `readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })` and the entry's own isDirectory(). `statSync` is not declared by the folder's type-only node:fs shim (fe-s-1/node-builtins.d.ts), while the withFileTypes:true overload of readdirSync IS, and its entry type already carries isFile()/isDirectory(). Same partition of entries into directories and .tsx files -- SCANNED holds at 38 files, identical to the pre-repair baseline. The eighth and last base TS error (TS2305) is gone.

mutant.description: A for-loop that registers tests can silently register ZERO of them, and an inverted regex assertion still passes vacuously -- both failure modes would read as a clean 86 pass. So both repairs were mutated at once and re-run: (a) census.test.ts's converted assertion flipped to expect(UNRESOLVED_MARKER.test(row.path ?? '')).toBe(true), asserting every REUSED path DOES carry the UNRESOLVED marker; (b) colour-law.test.ts's walkTsx recursion replaced by `if (entry.isDirectory()) continue`, so the withFileTypes entry's own isDirectory() no longer drives the walk.
mutant.expected: (a) exactly the 27 REUSED rows fail, each named individually -- proving the loop registers one live test per row and the converted regex assertion actually evaluates in the correct orientation; (b) SCANNED drops far below 38 -- proving the Dirent's isDirectory() is genuinely the thing driving recursion, i.e. a faithful statSync replacement rather than a vacuous one.
mutant.observed: 27 fail / 59 pass / 332 expect() calls, rc=1, with individually named failures (e.g. 'every census row is REUSED with an existing path, or NEW with a non-empty reason > row YAxis') -- 27 is exactly the REUSED count printed by the census line; and 'SCANNED: 1 files' against the baseline's 38. Both arms fired as predicted. Mutation reverted; `git status --porcelain -- src | wc -l` then read 0 against commit 2750d80b, so the restored files are byte-identical to the committed ones, and all three live criteria were re-run clean afterwards.
